steps.title: Read OpenCV measurements
steps.detail: OpenCV 5.0.0 measured hi-vis coverage 0.0% across 0 orange contours, 1 panel-shaped regions, and 1 yellow or red placard regions.

steps.title: Measure the panel interior
steps.detail: Interior edge density is 1.5%, below the 8% open-gear threshold. The cover is treated as latched.

steps.title: Check the jobsite policy
steps.detail: No critical exposure. Next action is an SMS to the crew lead. ticket.create will be skipped.

rules.detail: Hi-vis coverage is 0.0%, under the 4% torso threshold.

steps.title: Open an urgent office ticket
steps.detail: Policy returned HOLD. The crew can correct this on site, so no urgent ticket is opened.

steps.title: Draft the text
steps.detail: Drafted a HOLD text to crew-lead. The wording comes from the policy branch, not a fixed script.

output.body: FieldSight HOLD on the electrical call (INS-7094F2F9). Issue: no hi-vis vest in the photo. Fix it and shoot the panel again. No office ticket yet.

steps.title: Write the clearance note
steps.detail: The note records the measurements and which tools the branch actually ran.
